subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Cross-cutting runtime object patterns: UI element geometry and layout with a shared render sink (0x004DCA80), scene-graph child enumeration and geometry building, a wheel-ground contact database, HUD element registration/configuration, subsystem readiness slot queries, and the vehicle physics actor offset region 0x32BC-0x3D60 (anti-roll damping, force projection, track-distance, solver dispatch). The grouping is by shared offset ranges and shared callees; no single subsystem is proven.

summary: This proposal organizes 22 generic runtime functions into conservative classes: a UIElementLayout cluster (position/alignment fields 0x8-0x1C rendering through 0x004DCA80), scene-graph classes (SceneGraphNode child query/classification, SceneGraphGeometryBuilder, FreeableResourceHolder destructor), the WheelGroundContactDatabase, HUD-related classes (UIElementRegistry, HUDElementConfigArray, SubsystemSlotProvider), the VehiclePhysicsActor grouping over the contiguous 0x32BC-0x3D60 region, and small single-purpose classes (RPMRangeTable, SegmentInterpolationTable, TeamColorRenderObject, ScoringFieldSelector). All ownership tiers stay within DERIVED/GUESS/UNKNOWN; every packet field offset is preserved on its own base; the unbound read-only globals and the indirectly dispatched callees are recorded as unresolved.

function_roles.role: Compute and store a screen position under one of nine alignment modes (0-8) then render via the element render sink
Write the caller-supplied value into this+0x1C then forward to the element render sink and propagate its result
Two-field getter: copy this+0x14 and this+0x18 into caller outputs guarded on non-null
Three-field getter: copy this+0x08/+0x0C/+0x10 into caller outputs guarded on non-null
Single-resource destructor: free the resource pointer at this+0x14 through the free wrapper when non-null
Compute the maximum per-child classification across scene-graph children using child-count and indexed accessor
Search scene-graph children for the maximum squared 3D vector magnitude, gated by per-child detail level
Build scene-graph geometry: per-child vertex records, triangle adjacency, and a transform array
Update the wheel-ground contact database after inserting a new contact depth; return whether any contact data changed
One-time lazy initialization of a UI element: list-front move, position/color apply, initialized flag, activation sound, registry registration
Query subsystem readiness by index 0-13 across two slot arrays and two dedicated subsystem slots
Scale two per-child floats across scene-graph children, optionally climbing the parent chain
Select the value written to the scoring field at +0x984: delegated result or global default depending on the scoring gate flag
Per-frame axle damping update: clear wheel-force accumulators, handle the idle path, interpolate damper velocity, distribute anti-roll force
Per-actor motion post-processing: lazy-init subsystems, advance the state machine, interpolate damping, select force-feedback source, solve tire-brush forces, conditionally clamp velocity
Compute the negated scalar projection of a force vector onto a direction vector; 0.0 when the direction is zero
Compute an interpolated along-track distance relative to a track segment with lap-wraparound correction
Apply a team-color scale to a render object and propagate it downstream when the object's team color differs from the player's vehicle
Conditional physics solver dispatch gated on the constraint field at +0x32BC
Parse minimum/maximum/natural RPM key-values for a gear index 0-4 into the receiver's float range array
Piecewise interpolation over a segment table with vtable-dispatch of each participating segment object
Per-index element configuration: delegate to HUD element config, flag the element, copy a 3-float payload

classes.name: UIElementLayout
classes.responsibility: UI element carrying a position (X/Y at +0x8/+0xC, Z or size at +0x10), width/height at +0x14/+0x18, and a setter field at +0x1C. Alignment-mode position computation (0x004DCDD0), a field-setter trampoline (0x004DCF20), a two-field getter (0x004DCF30) and a three-field getter (0x004DCF50) all render/forward through the shared element render sink 0x004DCA80.

classes.name: SceneGraphNode
classes.responsibility: Scene-graph node owning children (enumerated via SceneGraphChildCount 0x0054C210 and LinkedListIndexedAccessor 0x0054C230), a parent pointer at +0x4C for chain climbing, and flag/classification state at +0x20 and +0x46. Children carry per-child floats at +244/+248 (velocity/fade per DERIVED names) and a flags dword at +20 documented only by raw source.

classes.name: SceneGraphGeometryBuilder
classes.responsibility: Geometry setup object (this of 0x004DE610): stores the root scene node at +0x4, child count at +0x8, per-child record array at +0xC, transform count at +0x10, transform array at +0x14, and a fill flag at +0x18. Builds per-child vertex records, triangle adjacency, and a two-pass index buffer.

classes.name: FreeableResourceHolder
classes.responsibility: Object holding a single resource pointer at +0x14 that is freed through FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF) by its destructor 0x004DD4D0 when non-null; used by array-cleanup and dual-array destructor paths.

classes.name: WheelGroundContactDatabase
classes.responsibility: Wheel-ground contact bookkeeping object: current depth key at +0x0, group count at +0x8 with descriptor array at +0xC, secondary contact count at +0x10 with array at +0x14, sorted entry count at +0x18, and per-entry contact data at +0x20. 0x004DF110 maintains the sorted contact-entry list and mutates vertex contact groups with soft-sphere deformation, relaxation, secondary resolution, and normal recompute.

classes.name: UIElementRegistry
classes.responsibility: UI element registry object: 0x004E0D00 lazily initializes an element (list-front move, position/color apply, initialized flag at a2+64), plays the activation sound indexed by this+0x964, and registers/updates the element in global lookup arrays against the registry handle dword_5EA560 unless the global mode flag dword_8AB6E4 equals 2.

classes.name: SubsystemSlotProvider
classes.responsibility: Owner of subsystem readiness state: 0x004E18C0 queries readiness for indices 0-13, using a stride-296 slot array anchored at this+324 and a stride-68 array at this+1236 (raw constants, no packet field refs) plus dedicated pointer/ready-byte pairs for subsystems 4 (+0x5E4/+0x624) and 5 (+0x628/+0x668). Ready iff the slot pointer is allocated and its ready byte at slot+64 is zero.

classes.name: VehiclePhysicsActor
classes.responsibility: Vehicle/actor physics state over the contiguous offset region 0x32BC-0x3D60 plus contact-subsystem anchors at +0xD0C/+0xD4C. Anti-roll axle damping and wheel-force distribution (0x004E51A0), per-actor motion post-processing with force-feedback selection and velocity clamping (0x004ED030), negated force-direction projection (0x004EFF00), along-track distance with lap wrap (0x004F01B0), and the gated solver dispatch (0x004F1860). Grouping is an inference from the shared +0x32BC gate and contiguous offsets; single-object ownership is not proven by the packet.

classes.name: RPMRangeTable
classes.responsibility: Receiver object holding per-gear RPM range floats at this[3*a3+1..3] (minimum, maximum, natural). 0x004F6BF0 parses the aMinimumrpm/aMaximumrpm/aNaturalrpm config keys for a guarded gear index 0-4, scaling RPM values by the rad/s conversion constant.

classes.name: SegmentInterpolationTable
classes.responsibility: Piecewise interpolation table: segment count at +0x0, segment low/high/third float triples from +0x4 with 12-byte stride, and a callback-object array at +0x40. 0x004F6D90 scans the parameter window, invokes each skipped segment's object via vtable+8, and blends between adjacent segments invoking vtable+4.

classes.name: TeamColorRenderObject
classes.responsibility: Render/team-color object: render-object pointer at +0x0 and team-color identifier at +0x4. 0x004F0D20 defaults the scale to 1.0, and when the identifier differs from the current player's vehicle field at +18580 (dword_7C54F0 indexed by dword_7C54DC) it runs a guarded render call and a 3D matrix transform whose carry flags select the renderer team-color scale at dword_7CF83C, then propagates the scale downstream.

classes.name: ScoringFieldSelector
classes.responsibility: Object with a scoring field at +0x984. 0x004E2C70 writes either the delegated x87 result (when the scoring gate flag dword_8AB6E4 equals 2, delegating to 0x004B9CE0 with &dword_8AB6EC) or the global default double dbl_8AFEA0 cast to float.

classes.name: HUDElementConfigArray
classes.responsibility: Float-array HUD element table: 0x004F8850 configures the element indexed by a2 through HUDElementConfig (0x004F87C0), flags it by writing 1 to this[8*a2+49], and copies a 3-float payload into this[8*a2+50..52]. Element stride of 32 floats is implied by the expressions.

state_machines.name: UIElementAlignmentMode
transitions: Jump table jpt_4DCDE4 at 0x004DCEBC dispatches alignment mode a5 (0-8); any out-of-range value falls through to the default path which renders without recomputing position

state_machines.name: SubsystemReadyFlag
transitions: Slot pointer allocated AND ready byte at slot+64 zero => Ready; otherwise NotReady; out-of-range index => NotReady

state_machines.name: WheelContactDirty
transitions: Change flag set once any mutation path runs; dirty pass marks every group target by clearing 0xFEFFFFDF and setting 0x400000, driving the normal recompute

state_machines.name: ActorFrameStateMachine
transitions: StateTransition(this+0x32C0, 0) advanced each frame; a one-shot flag at +0x3D60 is cleared so the transition runs once

interfaces.name: SceneGraphChildQuery
interfaces.purpose: Enumeration of scene-graph children: child count and indexed child fetch. Consumed by the scene-graph classes.

interfaces.name: PackedArrayAccessor
interfaces.purpose: Total-size and indexed-lookup accessors for packed element arrays, used during geometry build and magnitude search.

interfaces.name: MemoryAllocator
interfaces.purpose: Allocation/free service behind the geometry builder and resource destructor: operator-new wrapper and free wrapper.

interfaces.name: ElementRenderSink
interfaces.purpose: Shared render entry point for UI elements: position stored fields are rendered through it by the UI layout cluster.

interfaces.name: HUDElementConfigService
interfaces.purpose: HUD element configuration service consumed by the per-index configurator and by the anti-roll update for element 39.

interfaces.name: ConfigRecordReader
interfaces.purpose: Configuration record iteration and key-value parsing used by the RPM range loader.

interfaces.name: SegmentEvaluationTarget
interfaces.purpose: Objects dispatched per segment of the interpolation table via vtable+4 (evaluate) and vtable+8 (finalize). Callee identities are indirect and unresolved.

compatibility_contracts.name: UIElementLayoutAlignmentDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: Alignment mode a5 (0-8) selects how the X/Y anchors are computed from width/height; a4 is stored unconditionally into the +0x10 field at entry; an out-of-range mode takes the default path that renders via 0x004DCA80 without recomputing position (previous position is rendered). A replacement must preserve the nine modes and the default-fall-through behavior.

compatibility_contracts.name: SceneGraphChildEnumeration
compatibility_contracts.description: Scene-graph children are enumerated via SceneGraphChildCount (0x0054C210) and LinkedListIndexedAccessor (0x0054C230); parent-chain climbs read the parent pointer at node+0x4C and terminate on a null pointer. Child classification reads the child flags dword at +20 and the float at +244.

compatibility_contracts.name: WheelContactDirtyNotification
compatibility_contracts.description: When the wheel-ground contact database mutates any contact data, the change flag is set and every group target is marked by clearing flags with 0xFEFFFFDF and setting 0x400000; the normal recompute follows. A replacement must emit the dirty notification so renderers recompute face normals.

compatibility_contracts.name: SubsystemReadyQuerySemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: Readiness for subsystem index 0-13: a subsystem is ready only when its slot pointer is allocated AND its ready byte (slot+64) is zero; an out-of-range index reports not ready. Subsystem 4 uses +0x5E4/+0x624, subsystem 5 uses +0x628/+0x668.

compatibility_contracts.name: UIRegistryElementKeying
compatibility_contracts.description: UI elements are registered/updated in global lookup arrays keyed by their first dword matching the element pointer; a matched entry whose first value is -1 is handed to a lookup helper; the global mode flag dword_8AB6E4 equal to 2 bypasses the registry tail. The element lookup arrays are indexed via the registry handle dword_5EA560.

compatibility_contracts.name: RPMRangeParseSemantics
compatibility_contracts.description: Gear index a3 is guarded to 0..4; minimum/maximum RPM values are scaled by the rad/s conversion constant; natural RPM stores the reciprocal of the converted value, or 0.0 when the parsed natural RPM is not positive; a read status of exactly 2 terminates parsing early. Receiver layout is this[3*a3+1..3].

compatibility_contracts.name: ScoringGateFlagDispatch
compatibility_contracts.description: When the scoring gate flag dword_8AB6E4 equals 2, the scoring field at +0x984 receives the delegated x87 result from 0x004B9CE0(&dword_8AB6EC); otherwise it receives dbl_8AFEA0 cast to float.

compatibility_contracts.name: ForceFeedbackSourceSelection
compatibility_contracts.description: The force-feedback output at +0x3A70 is copied from the active-contact source (+0x3A80) when the contact pointer at +0xD0C is non-null and the contact-ready byte at +0xD4C is clear; otherwise the inactive-contact source (+0x3A7C) is used.

compatibility_contracts.name: DampingHalfStepInterpolation
compatibility_contracts.description: Each actor update steps the damping value at +0x3A6C halfway toward its target at +0x3A78 when they differ: (target + value) * 0.5.

unresolved: Object owners for most functions are UNKNOWN in the packet; the classes here are conservative groupings by shared offset ranges and shared callees, not proven single objects.

The vehicle physics offsets 0x32BC-0x3D60 form one contiguous region used by five functions, but no packet evidence proves a single owning object; the VehiclePhysicsActor grouping is an inference (shared +0x32BC gate is the strongest link).

Equal offsets on different bases are kept as separate fields (e.g. +0x14 on UIElementLayout/FreeableResourceHolder/SceneGraphGeometryBuilder, +0x20 on SceneGraphNode/WheelGroundContactDatabase, +0x00/+0x04/+0x08 on WheelGroundContactDatabase vs SegmentInterpolationTable vs TeamColorRenderObject); common ownership is not proven.

Read-only globals flt_59E420/59E430/59E43C/59E440/59E450/59E46C/59E670/59E7F8/59ED18/59EF78, flt_5ACD3C/5AD13C/5AD144/5AD148 and dword_8ACEE0 are flagged by packet facts but do not appear in the raw bodies; none is bound to a specific instruction.
global:0x004E1958 follows the SubsystemReadyQuery jump table in memory and is flagged as data; it is not referenced by the function body.
Child struct offsets +244/+248 (scene-graph floats) and +288 (triangle count) and the +20 flag bits are documented only by the raw source, not by packet field evidence.
field:this:0x00000020 has different meaning per class: child-class flags on SceneGraphNode, per-entry contact data on WheelGroundContactDatabase.
field:obj:0x00004040 (the session-state flag object read by ProjectedDistanceWithLapWrap) has no named owner.
The vtable +4/+8 dispatch in SegmentInterpolationTable is indirect; callee identities, the argument literal 2, and the trailing 0 are unresolved.

The caller relationship of SegmentInterpolationTable to SuspensionForceComputationWithPerCornerVirtualDi (0x004F8440) is inferred from the call graph; 0x004F8440 is outside the packet's allowed evidence refs.
SubsystemSlotProvider's stride-296 (this+324) and stride-68 (this+1236) slot arrays come from raw constants and have no packet field refs; only the dedicated subsystem 4/5 fields are typed.
HUDElementConfigArray's 32-float element stride and the flag/payload positions are implied by the index expressions, not confirmed by packet fields.

UIElementRegistry's global lookup arrays unk_5EA5A8..5EA5C8 and the helper calls sub_410AF0, ArithmeticComparison_df90 and NestedLoopCall are present in raw source but absent from the packet fact surface.
RPMRangeTable's receiver array layout (this[3*a3+1..3]) is untyped; parameter a2 is passed by the caller but never referenced by the body.
The ABI lead names Camera_FOV_Zoom_by_Proximity (for 0x004F0D20) and other LEGACY abi leads contradict observed behavior and are not treated as evidence.
